versions.yaml:
formId: system-provider-composition-v1
title: "Provider"
# Merges the 7 formerly-separate clinic-management forms (system-hospital-profile-v1,
# system-locations-profile-v1, system-staff-profile-v1, system-services-profile-v1,
# system-office-hours-profile-v1, system-consents-profile-v1, system-appointments-profile-v1)
# into one Organization-anchored composition — the clinic-management-side mirror of
# system-encounter-composition-v1.yaml's Patient-side merge. Organization MUST stay
# composition[0] — yaml-to-questionnaire.js derives subjectType only from
# composition[0].resourceType, same hard constraint as the Encounter file.
#
# Administrator is deliberately NOT its own block here — it stays a staff_role choice value
# (confirmed decision, not an oversight) since it has no fields distinct from Staff today.
#
# Hospital's own 3 ABDM sub-blocks (facility-type/location/registration) stay separate,
# non-repeating blocks rather than being collapsed into section_hospital — Hospital never
# repeats, so there's no correspondence-across-instances risk the way there would be for Staff
# (see below), and keeping them separate minimizes changes to the already-delicate ABDM
# registration field set.
#
# Staff's 3 former blocks (core/PractitionerRole/ABDM-registration) ARE collapsed into one
# section_staff block, repeats:true — collapsing is required here: if core/role/ABDM-
# registration stayed 3 independently-repeating sibling blocks, instance N of "core" would have
# no guaranteed correspondence to instance N of "role" for the same staff member once there's
# more than one. Each field keeps its original, accurate FHIR path even though they now share
# one block.
composition:
  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital
    label: "Hospital Details"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_name"
        path: "Organization.name"
        label: "Hospital Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "hospital_legalname"
        path: "Organization.alias"
        label: "Legal / Trade Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_type"
        path: "Organization.type"
        label: "Facility Type"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Hospital","Clinic","Pharmacy","Laboratory","Imaging Centre"]
      - id: "hospital_npi"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "NPI / Registration No."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_address"
        path: "Organization.address.text"
        label: "Street Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_city"
        path: "Organization.address.city"
        label: "City"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_state"
        path: "Organization.address.state"
        label: "State"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_pin"
        path: "Organization.address.postalCode"
        label: "PIN Code"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_country"
        path: "Organization.address.country"
        label: "Country"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_phone"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Primary Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_whatsapp"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "WhatsApp Number"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_email"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Email Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_website"
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Website URL"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_facility_type
    label: "Facility Type & Ownership"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_ownership_code"
        path: "Organization.type"
        label: "Ownership Code (HFR master: OWNER)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_type"
        path: "Organization.type"
        label: "Facility Type Code (HFR master: facility-types)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_subtype"
        path: "Organization.type"
        label: "Facility Sub-Type Code (HFR master: facility-sub-types)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_operational_status"
        path: "Organization.active"
        label: "Operational Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Functional","Non-Functional"]

  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_location
    label: "ABDM Location (LGD Codes)"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_state_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.address.state"
        label: "State LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/states)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_district_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.address.district"
        label: "District LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/districts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_subdistrict_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.address.district"
        label: "Sub-District LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/subdistricts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  # STARTER FIELD SET — see system-hospital-profile-v1.yaml's original header comment (ported
  # verbatim): New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf's full field list could not be extracted this
  # session. Not complete; extend once the PDF has been extracted.
  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_registration
    label: "ABDM Facility Registration"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_tracking_id"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "Tracking ID (from Basic Information step)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_id"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "ABDM Facility ID (from Submit step)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_abdm_software_code"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "ABDM-Compliant Software Code (get-Software-details master)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_source_of_information"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "Source of Information"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_source_unique_id"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "Source Unique ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Location
    id: section_location
    label: "Branch / Location Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "location_name"
        path: "Location.name"
        label: "Branch Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "location_address"
        path: "Location.address.text"
        label: "Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "location_phone"
        path: "Location.telecom.value"
        label: "Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Practitioner
    id: section_staff
    label: "Staff Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "staff_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.text"
        label: "Full Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "staff_phone"
        path: "Practitioner.telecom.value"
        label: "Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_email"
        path: "Practitioner.telecom.value"
        label: "Email"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_qualification"
        path: "Practitioner.qualification.code"
        label: "Qualification"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_license"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "License / Registration ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_status"
        path: "Practitioner.active"
        label: "Active"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      # staff_role/staff_specialty were PractitionerRole.code/PractitionerRole.specialty across 2
      # separate blocks before this merge — collapsing Staff into one repeating block (required so
      # a repeating instance's core/role/ABDM-registration fields stay correlated; see this file's
      # header comment) means every field here must share the block's one resourceType, and the
      # compiler enforces path.startsWith(`${resourceType}.`) with no exception. Practitioner.
      # extension is FHIR's own designed-for-this escape hatch for an attribute with no first-
      # class field — reused across both, same convention this file's own ABDM fields already use
      # (7 fields sharing Practitioner.identifier.value below).
      - id: "staff_role"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        label: "Role"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Chief of Medicine","Doctor","Nurse","Administrator","Receptionist","Radiologist"]
      - id: "staff_specialty"
        path: "Practitioner.extension"
        label: "Specialty"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["Cardiology","Neurology","Radiology","Pediatrics","Orthopedics","Dermatology","General Medicine","ENT","Ophthalmology","Psychiatry"]
      # ABDM's own fields, not this app's clinical vocabulary — staff_abdm_role (Doctor/Nurse/
      # Facility Manager) is deliberately separate from staff_role above (Chief of Medicine/.../
      # Administrator): the same person can hold a clinical role here and a different ABDM role
      # in HPR's own registry. staff_aadhaar/staff_otp/staff_hpr_password are intentionally NOT
      # fields on this form — see docs/onboarding/04-security-notes.md. They live only in the
      # onboarding page's transient state so there is no code path by which
      # SystemForms.saveDataRecord() could ever persist them.
      - id: "staff_first_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.given"
        label: "First Name (as on Aadhaar)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_middle_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.given"
        label: "Middle Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_last_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.family"
        label: "Last Name (as on Aadhaar)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_abdm_role"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "ABDM Role"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Doctor","Nurse","Facility Manager"]
      - id: "staff_hp_category_code"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "HP Category Code (HPR master: system-of-medicine)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_hp_subcategory_code"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "HP Sub-Category Code"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_state_code"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "State LGD Code (HPR master: states)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_district_code"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "District LGD Code (HPR master: districts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_council"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "Registered with a Medical/Nursing Council"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      - id: "staff_hprid"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "HPR ID (assigned after creation)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "staff_hpr_id_number"
        path: "Practitioner.identifier.value"
        label: "HPR ID Number (assigned after creation)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: HealthcareService
    id: section_services_matrix
    label: "Service Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "service_name"
        path: "HealthcareService.name"
        label: "Service Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "service_specialty_category"
        path: "HealthcareService.category"
        label: "Core Specialty Category"
        description: "The primary clinical vertical or domain classification such as Cardiology, Pediatrics, Optometry, or Lab Diagnostics."
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Cardiology", "Pediatrics", "Ophthalmology", "Optometry", "Diet & Wellness", "General Medicine"]
        required: true
      - id: "service_program_name"
        path: "HealthcareService.program"
        label: "Target Clinical Program Name"
        description: "The formal named program or specific diagnostic track offered, like Type 2 Diabetes Management or Periodontal Charting."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "service_description"
        path: "HealthcareService.comment"
        label: "Description"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Location
    id: section_hours
    label: "Operating Hours"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "hours_days"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.daysOfWeek"
        label: "Days of Week"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["mon","tue","wed","thu","fri","sat","sun"]
      - id: "hours_open"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.openingTime"
        label: "Opening Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hours_close"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.closingTime"
        label: "Closing Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hours_allday"
        path: "Location.hoursOfOperation.allDay"
        label: "Open All Day"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"

  - resourceType: Consent
    id: section_consent
    label: "Consent Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "consent_title"
        path: "Consent.sourceAttachment.title"
        label: "Title"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "consent_category"
        path: "Consent.category"
        label: "Consent Type"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["HIPAA Privacy Notice","Informed Consent for Treatment","Financial Responsibility","Telemedicine Consent","Photography / Research","Minor Treatment Consent"]
        required: true
      - id: "consent_status"
        path: "Consent.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["draft","active","inactive","entered-in-error","rejected"]
      - id: "consent_datetime"
        path: "Consent.dateTime"
        label: "Date Signed"
        uiComponent: "DatePicker"
      - id: "consent_expiry"
        path: "Consent.provision.period.end"
        label: "Expiry Date"
        uiComponent: "DatePicker"

  - resourceType: Appointment
    id: section_appointment
    label: "Appointment Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "appt_patient"
        path: "Appointment.participant.actor"
        label: "Patient"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_staff"
        path: "Appointment.participant.actor"
        label: "Staff Member"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_status"
        path: "Appointment.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["proposed","booked","arrived","fulfilled","cancelled","noshow"]
        required: true
      - id: "appt_start"
        path: "Appointment.start"
        label: "Start Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_end"
        path: "Appointment.end"
        label: "End Time"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "appt_description"
        path: "Appointment.description"
        label: "Reason / Notes"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

item.description: The primary clinical vertical or domain classification such as Cardiology, Pediatrics, Optometry, or Lab Diagnostics.
The formal named program or specific diagnostic track offered, like Type 2 Diabetes Management or Periodontal Charting.

versions.yaml:
formId: system-patient-profile-v1
title: "Patients"
composition:
  - resourceType: Patient
    id: section_patient
    label: "Patient Details"
    fields:
      - id: "patient_name"
        path: "Patient.name.text"
        label: "Full Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "patient_gender"
        path: "Patient.gender"
        label: "Gender"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["male","female","other","unknown"]
      - id: "patient_birthdate"
        path: "Patient.birthDate"
        label: "Date of Birth"
        uiComponent: "DatePicker"
      - id: "patient_emergency_contact_name"
        path: "Patient.contact.name.text"
        label: "Emergency Contact Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "patient_emergency_contact_phone"
        path: "Patient.contact.telecom.value"
        label: "Emergency Contact Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

formId: system-encounter-composition-v1
title: "Consultation"
# Merges the former system-encounter-intake-v1 / system-vitals-v1 / system-consultation-soap-v1 /
# system-prescription-v1 / system-billing-v1 into one Encounter-centered composition — one
# record per patient visit instead of five separately-keyed ones, loosely "linked" only by each
# copying the same encounter id into its own *_encounter_ref string field (never a real FHIR
# Reference). Encounter MUST stay composition block 0 — yaml-to-questionnaire.js derives
# subjectType only from composition[0].resourceType. UI-facing label is "Consultation"; the FHIR
# resourceType stays Encounter.
composition:
  - resourceType: Encounter
    id: section_encounter
    label: "Encounter Details"
    fields:
      - id: "encounter_patient_ref"
        path: "Encounter.subject"
        label: "Patient"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "encounter_chief_complaint"
        path: "Encounter.reasonCode"
        label: "Chief Complaint"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "encounter_status"
        path: "Encounter.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["arrived","in-progress","finished","cancelled"]
        required: true
      - id: "encounter_priority"
        path: "Encounter.priority"
        label: "Triage Priority"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Normal","Emergency"]

  - resourceType: Observation
    id: section_vitals
    label: "Vitals Capture"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "vitals_systolic"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Systolic BP"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "vitals_diastolic"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Diastolic BP"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "vitals_pulse"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Pulse (bpm)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "vitals_temperature"
        path: "Observation.component.valueQuantity.value"
        label: "Temperature (°F)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Condition
    id: section_soap
    label: "SOAP Note"
    fields:
      - id: "soap_subjective"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Subjective"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["complains", "reports", "states", "feels", "patient says"]
      - id: "soap_objective"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Objective"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["exam reveals", "vitals", "observed", "measured", "on examination"]
      - id: "soap_assessment"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Assessment"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["diagnosis", "assessment", "likely", "impression", "consistent with"]
      - id: "soap_plan"
        path: "Condition.note.text"
        label: "Plan"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        keywords: ["plan", "prescribe", "recommend", "follow-up", "advised"]

  - resourceType: MedicationRequest
    id: section_prescription
    label: "Medication"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "rx_medication"
        path: "MedicationRequest.medicationCodeableConcept"
        label: "Medication"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "rx_dosage"
        path: "MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.text"
        label: "Dosage Instructions"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "rx_status"
        path: "MedicationRequest.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["active","completed","cancelled"]

  - resourceType: Invoice
    id: section_billing
    label: "Billing Details"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "billing_total"
        path: "Invoice.totalGross.value"
        label: "Total Amount"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "billing_status"
        path: "Invoice.status"
        label: "Status"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["draft","issued","balanced","cancelled"]
        required: true
      - id: "billing_payment_method"
        path: "Invoice.paymentTerms"
        label: "Payment Method"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Cash","Card","UPI","Insurance"]
